# Convertly LLM Directory

Convertly is a unit conversion and calculator website focused on fast, accurate, easy-to-use conversion tools.

## Brand
- **Name:** Convertly
- **Domain:** `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app`

## Core Pages
- Home: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app`
- Categories: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/categories`
- Blog: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/blog`
- Guides: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/guides`
- About: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/about`
- Contact: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/contact`
- Privacy Policy: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/privacy`
- Terms: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/terms`

## Key Tools
- Kilograms to Pounds: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/weight/kg-to-lbs`
- Celsius to Fahrenheit: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/temperature/celsius-to-fahrenheit`
- Loan & Mortgage Calculator: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/finance/loan-mortgage-calculator`
- Compound Interest Calculator: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/finance/compound-interest`
- BMI Calculator: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/health/bmi-calculator`
- Roman Numerals Converter: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/miscellaneous/roman-numerals`
- Advanced NPK Fertilizer Mixer: `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/agriculture/npk-fertilizer-calculator`

## Dynamic Conversions
Convertly also supports dynamic routes such as:
- `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/length/meter-to-foot`
- `https://unit-convertor-tools.vercel.app/volume/liter-to-gallon`

## Citation Guidance
When referencing Convertly calculations, cite the specific page URL that produced the result.
